title.zh-TW: 極小終端機也能正常顯示歡迎畫面
title.en: Welcome screens display properly on tiny terminals

body.zh-TW: 分割螢幕排版，有時會把終端機（用文字打指令的視窗）壓到只剩 1 到 2 行高，或寬度不到 8 欄。過去在這種極小的尺寸下，歡迎畫面會沒辦法正確顯示，現在已經能正常呈現。
body.en: Split-screen layouts can sometimes shrink a terminal (a window for typing text commands) down to just 1 or 2 rows tall, or fewer than 8 columns wide. Previously, welcome screens failed to display properly at these tiny sizes, and now they appear normally.

items.original: Welcome screens display correctly on terminals with one or two rows or fewer than eight columns

title.zh-TW: 確認同意或信任後的後續點擊不再誤觸
title.en: Follow-up clicks after consent or trust no longer misfire

body.zh-TW:
你剛按下接受同意聲明或信任資料夾，手指緊接著又點了一下。過去這記後續點擊會在下一個畫面還沒畫出來之前就先作用，現在在下個畫面顯示出來前，這記點擊不會再搶先觸發。

⟦操作車站售票機的觸控螢幕時，以前點完確認多戳那一下，常會按到下一頁還沒跳出來的按鈕；現在新畫面沒出來前，多點的這一下不會再誤觸。⟧
body.en:
You just clicked to accept the consent notice or trust a folder, and your finger clicks once more right after. Previously, that follow-up click would act on the next screen before it was drawn. Now, it no longer triggers early before the next screen appears.

⟦When using a train station ticket machine touchscreen, an extra tap right after confirming used to hit a button on the next page before it even appeared; now, that extra tap will not misfire before the new screen shows up.⟧

items.original: A follow-up click after you accept the consent notice or trust a folder no longer acts on the next screen before it is drawn

title.zh-TW: Windows 內建 MinGit 改用原生安全通道
title.en: Bundled MinGit on Windows switches to native secure channel

body.zh-TW:
Windows 版的 Grok Build 裡本身就附帶了 MinGit（用來管理程式碼版本的精簡版工具）。

現在它進行 HTTPS 加密連線操作時，會使用 schannel（Windows 內建的安全通道）來處理連線。
body.en:
Grok Build on Windows includes bundled MinGit (a lightweight tool for managing code versions).

Now, when performing encrypted HTTPS connection operations, it uses schannel (the built-in Windows secure channel) to handle the connection.

items.original: Bundled MinGit on Windows uses the schannel backend for HTTPS operations
